raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Consolidate four model documentation additions into a single PR per maintainer feedback.

**Models added:**
- google/gemma-2-2b-it (Gemma 2)
- ibm-granite/granite-swash-2b (Granite SWA)
- Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B (Qwen 3 mini)

All models validated on H100 NVL with v0.31.0. Previously submitted as individual PRs (#43656, #53403, #56339, #56475) but consolidated per reviewer feedback to reduce churn.

nodes.body:
@hmellor Thanks for the feedback on the DCO issue. I've fixed it and created a new consolidated PR #61254 with the proper sign-off format. All four models (Gemma-2, Granite SWA, Qwen3-0.6B) are now documented in a single change instead of four separate one-liners, as you suggested.

A few questions on next steps:

1. If #61254 merges: That puts me at 4 authored merges. I have two more substantial PRs ready for review (#55752 for matmul determinism, #45819 for GDN batch invariance). Should I focus on getting those reviewed, or would validating more models for batch invariance documentation be more valuable for the project right now?
2. Community validation: I've been offering H100 NVL validation on open batch-invariance PRs (like Mamba2 #55627/#55905). Should I continue that work, or would you prefer I focus on getting my own PRs merged first?

Just want to make sure I'm contributing in the way that's most helpful.

Thanks again!
@hmellor ✅ DCO fixed with proper sign-off format. Ready to merge whenever you have a moment.

✅ Triggered [Buildkite CI #95994](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/95994) for commit `11fd530ed820`.

ℹ️ This PR is 82 commits behind upstream `main`. Merged upstream `main` into this branch as `11fd530ed820` before starting CI. Pull the branch before pushing more changes.

Thanks @yuvalluria!

You asked earlier if this was high value work for vLLM. Unfortunately, I don't think that it is. Batch invariance is a relatively niche feature and validating it on old architectures doesn't help the project much.

detail.title: [Docs] Add Gemma-2, Granite SWA, Qwen3-0.6B to batch invariance validated models

files.patch:
@@ -139,7 +139,11 @@ Batch invariance has been tested and verified on the following models:
 - **OLMo 2**: `allenai/OLMo-2-0425-1B-Instruct`
 - **ERNIE 4.5**: `baidu/ERNIE-4.5-0.3B-PT`
 - **SmolLM2**: `HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct`
+- **Gemma 2**: `google/gemma-2-2b-it`
 - **PLaMo3**: `pfnet/plamo-3-nict-2b-base`
+- **Granite MoE SWA**: `ibm-granite/granite-swash-3b-a600m` (MoE + sliding-window attention; FLASH_ATTN and TRITON_ATTN backends; FLEX_ATTENTION and decode-vs-prefill test excluded due to per-layer SWA KV window differences)
+- **Granite SWA**: `ibm-granite/granite-swash-2b` (sliding-window attention; FLASH_ATTN and TRITON_ATTN backends)
+- **Qwen3-0.6B**: `Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B`
 
 Other models may also work, but these have been explicitly validated. If you encounter issues with a specific model, please report them on the [GitHub issue tracker](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/new/choose).
